result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and dense on-street parallel parking. While the street is narrow, which naturally slows traffic, the lack of marked crossings and the visual obstruction caused by parked cars create risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street obscures sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No marked pedestrian crossings are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross mid-block without designated protection or priority.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the ends of the block to prevent parking near intersections and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees in the furniture zone to provide a physical buffer, improve the pedestrian environment, and psychologically slow traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes warrant, install a high-visibility marked crossing with appropriate signage.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a narrow urban sidewalk constrained by building frontages and on-street parking. The walkway is significantly obstructed by trash receptacles and architectural features like stairs, forcing a very narrow effective width for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Trash bins and building stairs significantly narrow the usable walking path, potentially forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk in front of the buildings

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles block the sightlines between pedestrians on the narrow sidewalk and moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and right side of the image

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the effective width of the sidewalk by extending the curb into the parking lane to create more space for pedestrians and utilities.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement off-street or recessed trash storage solutions to remove bins from the primary pedestrian clear zone.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban residential street with continuous sidewalks and parallel parking on both sides. The environment lacks dedicated pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, traffic calming measures, or buffers between the walkway and the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway without Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is narrow and lacks a furniture zone or planting strip to separate pedestrians from the adjacent parking and travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street, particularly on the right side where buildings are flush with the walkway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or mid-block access points to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban sidewalk in a mixed-use area, currently obstructed by trash bags. Pedestrians are separated from the roadway by a line of parked cars, which also creates visual obstructions between the walkway and the street.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large bags of trash are piled on the sidewalk, significantly narrowing the usable walking space.
hazards.location_in_image: Center right, on the sidewalk in front of the storefronts.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and right side of the image.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Management
interventions.description: Implement regular trash collection schedules and enforce clear-path requirements to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is available for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the narrow walkway and the parking/travel lanes.
